data.name: Settings_Backups_Location_Hint
data.value: Empty means a service folder in the user profile — nothing appears next to the project. The path can also be set inside the project itself: it then travels with the file, and if that folder does not exist on another machine, the settings of whoever opened it are used.

data.name: Settings_Backups_ProjectOverride_Hint
data.value: The path is stored *inside the project itself* and travels with the file. If that folder does not exist on another machine there will be no error — *the settings of whoever opened it* are used instead.

data.name: Settings_Backups_Unsaved_Message
data.value:
The project has unsaved changes. The point taken before a rollback is made from the file on disk and will not preserve them — they will be lost.
Save them before rolling back? Yes — save and roll back, No — roll back and lose them, Cancel — do nothing.

data.value: Warning: after the rollback there will be less data than there is now.

data.name: Settings_Backups_Hint
data.value: A restore point records the state of the project before a save. Identical content is stored once, so images and avatars are not copied again for every point.

data.value: No points yet. The first one appears with the next project save.
